headline: Synchrony's CareCredit Expands Access to Financing for Health & Wellness Providers with New Stripe Partnership
summary: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF), a premier consumer financial services company, today announced a new integration with Stripe, the programmable financial services company, making it easier for Synchrony and Stripe's health and wellness providers and retailers to offer CareCredit financing as part of their online checkout experience.
